lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A multi-columnar array of circular high-luminance pixel clusters situated posterior to the gill region, showing a regular horizontal and vertical spacing.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear features of elevated intensity intersect with the primary blob array, forming a visible coordinate-like grid structure on the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal linear feature along the upper lateral flank exhibiting a high-contrast transition between superior illumination and inferior shadow.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, dark-toned silhouettes (commensal organisms) clustered along the ventral and ventrolateral regions.
